description: Teaching Water-Wise Landscape Design to Conserve Water in the Intermountain West is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by USFWS, U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service. Many homeowners feel unprepared to design their personal landscapes to be more water-wise. To bridge this knowledge gap and promote the conservation of municipal water through water-wise design, Utah State University’s Landscape Architecture and Environmental Planning (LAEP) Extension staff administer Design 4 Every Drop, a landscape design course for homeowners based on seven principles of ... Coverage: Utah (2024). The toolkit gives Utah as the location, 2024 as the year. The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
